# `WorldApi::get_cell_gas_amount`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-engine-side">engine-side</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **World API** (`src/plugins/api/world_api.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Returns one gas amount in a cell by stable substance id or alias.

## Signature

```rust
fn get_cell_gas_amount (& self , cell : UVec2 , substance : & str) -> Result < u32 , WorldApiError >
```
